purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, public-service routes, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Godhra local land-record custody is evidenced by official Gujarat government material listing the Panchmahals District Inspector of Land Records at Godhra and the Godhra City Survey Superintendent. Gujarat Revenue Department services and the national DILRMP page identify AnyRoR/E-Dhara, e-Milkat, and Bhunaksha context, but no safe anonymous native-ID-plus-complete-geometry response was verified.
registryAssessment: The Panchmahals DILR and Godhra City Survey Superintendent are local custodial roles evidenced by an official Gujarat government document. The Gujarat Revenue Department and DILRMP are broader state/national service or reporting sources and do not alone prove citywide open geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Gujarat Informatics Limited government tender document lists Superintendent Land Records cum Consolidation Officer Panchmahals at Godhra, District Inspector of Land Records Panchmahals at Godhra, and City Survey Superintendent, Godhra.
Official Gujarat Revenue Department H-Branch page describes state responsibility for survey, settlement, city survey, and Directorate of Land Records.
Official Gujarat Revenue Department service index links land-record, AnyRoR, property-card/e-Milkat, and revenue services.
Official Government of India DILRMP page lists Gujarat E-Dhara, Bhunaksha Gujarat, and E-Milkat categories; this is service context, not a parcel feature response.
Official State GIS Portal map page exposes administrative/tehsil map functions and disclaimers; reviewed route did not provide a verified Godhra parcel layer or safe feature response.
Official linked AnyRoR host for Gujarat land records; no parcel geometry response was retained.
Official linked e-Milkat property-card route; no parcel geometry response was retained.
